context:
Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).

2026-11-20 evidence. BenchBox: generator_specs.yaml sets market_history 541550; scaling.py computes max(1, int(541550 x SF)); generator/facts.py writes that many rows with a random security and a random date, so the count is not derived from securities x days; source_generators.py uses the same constant. The constant is R_H 541.55 for DailyMarket.txt in Poess et al., PVLDB vol. 7 p. 1367, Table 3 (the design paper), not the specification; the #4171 commit message calls it the specification's factor. TPC-DI v1.1.0 gives no DailyMarket row count (clause 2.1: row counts are 'determined by the data generator based on the Scale Factor'). 584,800 = 731 x 800; the official generator's config (DIGen 1.1.0 tpc-di-schema.xml, read from a third-party copy) computes 732 calendar days x 0.8 x SF = 585,600 per unit and marks it 'FAKE VALUE.customBB overrides this'. So the site's 'two years of trading days' is wrong: calendar days, and a placeholder. UNVERIFIED: DIGen's real DailyMarket row count (needs running DIGen.jar under its EULA); an estimate from securities alive in 2015-2017 gives about 546,900 per unit, within 1% of 541,550. Owner questions, none preselected: (a) keep 541,550 and correct the site text; (b) run DIGen at SF 3 or 5 and adopt the measured factor; (c) generate one row per alive security per calendar day; (b) and (c) change TPC-DI data digests. May DIGen.jar be run in /tmp to measure?

Owner decision 2026-11-20. Question: FactMarketHistory row count and the site text. Answer: "Recommended: keep 541,550, record the paper as the rationale, and correct the site sentence. No generator change." Source: owner's answer in the choice dialog, 2026-11-20. Rationale to record with code and page references: 541,550 per unit is the figure in the TPC-DI design paper (Poess et al., PVLDB vol. 7, Table 3); the specification gives no row count; DIGen's real count is unmeasured.

## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.

Rationale recorded 2026-11-20, each point read today. Code path: benchbox/core/tpcdi/generator_specs.yaml `rows_per_scale_factor.market_history: 541550`, read through `ROWS_PER_SCALE_FACTOR['market_history']` in generator/data.py and scaled in generator/facts.py (`_secondary_fact_row_counts`). Source of the figure: the TPC-DI design paper by the specification's authors, 'TPC-DI: The First Industry Benchmark for Data Integration', PVLDB 7(13), 2014, Table 3, DailyMarket.txt RH = 541.55, read as thousands of rows per scale-factor unit (the paper gives rows(SF) = SF * RF and does not state the unit; thousands is the reading consistent with its size column). The TPC-DI specification v1.1.0 itself contains no row counts at all: the page's other 'specification' figures (5,000 customers per unit, 86,400 times, 102 industries, 6 status types, 320 tax rates, 5 trade types, 25,933 dates) are also the paper's (section 3.2 and Table 2), not the specification's. 584,800 = 731 x 800: 731 is a count of calendar days in two years, not trading days; no measurement or source for it was found, and it is removed from the page. DIGen's real count is unmeasured. Generator unchanged. Site correction: benchbox-site#222 (into next).

It was closed with that difference recorded as 'cause not investigated'. The site text on `next` gives the arithmetic as trading days although 584800 / 800 is 731 calendar days.

## Change
Record the rationale: the generator code path that yields 541,550 per unit, the design paper table it matches, and the arithmetic for 584,800 (731 calendar days times 800). Keep the generator as it is. The site sentence is corrected under site-next-tpcdi-page-tradetype-and-market-history-text-20261120.

Decided: keep 541,550, no generator change (see context).

Review threads: the accepted text also said the agent never resolves a thread.
